column7: 2026-11-06: Migration in progress: only test/num.js converted to uvu. package.json test script is 'tape test/index.js test/unknown.js | tap-spec && uvu test num.js' (my choice: explicit lists because tap-spec can't parse uvu output). Next: convert index.js and unknown.js, moving each to the uvu list; when all done, script becomes 'uvu test' and remove tape and tap-spec from devDependencies. Also check pnpm-lock.yaml picked up uvu (git status did not show it modified).

2026-11-06: Tests: migrating to Node's built-in node:test, NOT uvu (supersedes the uvu decision). Reason: security review blocks adding new devDependencies to published packages. test/num.js stays uvu-converted for now; user will redo it with the rest. Don't add uvu.

2026-11-06: Test migration to node:test finished: all three test files converted (assert.deepStrictEqual/strictEqual), tape/tap-spec/uvu removed from devDependencies, test script is 'node --test test/'.
